class.name: anywheresoftware.b4a.objects.IME
class.comment: IME includes several utilities that will you help you manage the soft keyboard. A tutorial with a working example is available <link>here|https://www.b4x.com/android/forum/threads/handle-the-soft-keyboard-with-the-ime-library.14832/</link>.
class.event: HeightChanged (NewHeight As Int, OldHeight As Int)

method.name: IsEdgeToEdge
method.comment: Tests whether activity is running in edge to edge mode, based on targetSdkVersion, device version and windowOptOutEdgeToEdgeEnforcement flag.

method.name: GetActionBarHeight
method.comment: Returns the action bar height, or 0 if no action bar.

method.name: SetCustomFilter
method.comment: Sets a custom filter. EditText - The target EditText. DefaultInputType - Sets the keyboard mode. AcceptedCharacters - The accepted characters. Example: Create a filter that will accept IP addresses (numbers with multiple dots) IME.SetCustomFilter(EditText1, EditText1.INPUT_TYPE_NUMBERS, "0123456789.")

method.name: UpdatePercentageReference
method.comment: Updates the relative width and height for %x and %y calculations.

method.name: AddHeightChangedEvent
method.comment: Enables the HeightChanged and InsetsChanged events. The InsetsChanged event is only raised in edge to edge mode.

method.name: Initialize
method.comment: Initializes the object and sets the subs that will handle the events.

method.name: HideKeyboard
method.comment: Hides the soft keyboard if it is visible.

method.name: ShowKeyboard
method.comment: Sets the focus to the given view and opens the soft keyboard. The keyboard will only show if the view has received the focus.

method.name: AddHandleActionEvent
method.comment: Adds the HandleAction event to the given EditText.

method.name: GetContentRect
method.comment: Returns the content area after excluding system bars, display cutouts and the ActionBar.

method.name: SetLengthFilter
method.comment: Sets a filter that limits the maximum length to the specified value.
